mapper.select: SELECT SM.staff_no, SM.name, SM.auth_no, AM.permission_mask AS PermissionMask, SM.del, SA.email AS LoginId, SA.password_hash AS Password, SA.lockout_end AS LockOutDateTime, SA.access_failed_count AS FailedCount FROM staff_master SM INNER JOIN staff_auth SA ON SM.staff_no = SA.staff_no INNER JOIN auth_master AM ON SM.auth_no = AM.auth_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND SM.del = false AND SA.email = #{loginId}

SELECT SM.staff_no, SM.name, SM.auth_no, AM.permission_mask AS PermissionMask FROM staff_master SM INNER JOIN auth_master AM ON SM.auth_no = AM.auth_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND SM.del = false AND SM.staff_no = #{no}

SELECT SM.staff_no AS staffNo, SM.name, SM.auth_no AS authNo, SM.del AS delFlg, SA.email AS LoginId, SA.password_hash AS Password FROM staff_master SM INNER JOIN staff_auth SA ON SM.staff_no = SA.staff_no WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY SM.staff_no
